arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math

# Data for Rural Electrification Administration (millions of dollars)
# Calendar years 1961-1970
values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

# Calculate Theil index of dispersion
# T = (1/n) * sum((x_i / mean) * log(x_i / mean))
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f'Mean: {mean}')

theil_sum = 0
for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    theil_sum += ratio * math.log(ratio)

theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f'Theil index: {theil_index}')
print(f'Rounded to thousandths: {theil_index:.3f}')
"
